blocks.text: New supporting character for the Era Zero song cycle, within the proposed early history of Pale Concordance Station.

Neral is an embodied DBA person whose work is travel interpretation. They help explain destination laws, compatible bodies and differences in time scale. They are not a sentient routing system and do not own the station.
They compose Paths That Meet after sharing a bench with two travelers. Their bright, percussive musical voice is represented by the electric-piano lead in the listening arrangement.
Neral is not assigned membership in the Bridge Orders: travel between DBA worlds does not by itself establish work at the human boundary. Their later life is unspecified.
